title.narrative: Promoting Gender Transformative Communities through Civil Participation

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to empower CSOs of Uzbekistan to engage as independent actors of inclusive and effective democratic governance and development. To achieve this goal, the project pursues three intertwined specific objectives : The organizational capacity of CSOs will be str engthened, for them to advocate for and facilitate inclusive and equitable development ( SO1). This will also entail advancing constructive cooperation and dialogue towards GTT/C between communities, CSOs, and local authorities based on joint analyses of social constraints and exchanging knowledge and best practices. CSOs will contribute to the establishment of gender transformative territories/communities with active engagement of communities ( SO2).

The GTT/C approach to development will then be publicized and promoted from communal to national levels for decision makers and the wider public to recognize and disseminate it further
